run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the minimum number of jumps to reach the end of an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify minimum jump count correctness
review_f_gold: review f_gold dynamic programming approach for minimum jumps to reach end of array
